links.outcome: Proportion of normal or nonobstructive CAD diagnosed via ICA, AI triage versus usual care
links.effect: Protocol only; no results yet. 252 patients to be randomized 1:1; 81 enrolled as of April 14, 2025; results expected 2026.
links.quote: CarDIA-AI is a pragmatic, open-label, superior randomized controlled trial involving 2 Canadian cardiac centers.

unlisted_practices: Using AI risk prediction to triage elective outpatients to noninvasive CCTA versus invasive angiography

screen.reason: Protocol for a pragmatic randomized controlled trial (CarDIA-AI) evaluating the real-world deployment of an AI-based risk assessment and decision support tool for clinical triage of patients to CCTA vs invasive coronary angiography.

primary.practice: AI-based triage and decision support for diagnostic test selection
